title: Well-posed singular mean-field SPDE dynamics and propagation of chaos

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard functional analysis, measure theory and the author-cited classical theorems
standard_prerequisites.use: Standard prior results stay cited; complete source-local proofs and definitions retained.

core_obligations: Law-dependent coefficients of a two-dimensional singular SPDE require enhanced cross-noise objects and an integrable paracontrolled solution map before the law fixed point can close. Polynomial nonexplosion bounds and local Lipschitz continuity yield a deterministic lifespan, renormalized approximation and the interacting-field empirical limit; propagation of chaos is retained as the same main object’s direct limit conclusion.
